Name: Increased Sprinkler Range
Author: arjan3004
Description:
Improve the efficiency of your sprinklers! By default will increase the range of all sprinklers by 1.
You can increase (or even decrease) the value in the config.
Changes will take effect the day after the mod is installed.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/20745/20745-1711030113-1966250953.png[/img]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu [/url]to edit the settings in game﻿, the changes will take effect the next day.
Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6752]Range Highlight[/url] to see the range of the sprinklers when placing them.

[s]Want more control over your sprinklers use this mod instead: [/s][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17767][s]Better Sprinklers Plus[/s][/url] (When it is updated to 1.6)﻿[size=1]
